name: 1001-143-ornith-256k-litellm
note: Paxton 2026-09-10, source session [837df7], with an expert's live verification folded in. Surface ornith-1.5 256K as its OWN LiteLLM model. DB-OWNED, NO YAML CHANGE - deliberately, because any edit to infrastructure/litellm-config.yaml force-recreates the CT202 prod router. *** THE CONTEXT QUESTION IS ALREADY ANSWERED, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED - do not re-derive: an expert tested BOTH lanes directly on ptait01 by hiding a random code in a very long prompt. :11441 loaded 262144, 185,851-token prompt, returned ZX-800824 CORRECT in 285s. :11438 loaded 262144, 186,069-token prompt, returned ZX-161229 CORRECT in 84s. ~10.8 GB of each 24 GB card. *** THE LANDMINE: the 262144 comes from num_ctx INSIDE THE MODEL TAG, not the container. Both containers set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=16384 which the tag overrides - so if anyone rebuilds that tag WITHOUT num_ctx the lane SILENTLY DROPS TO 16K, which is exactly the qwen3.8--256k failure (advertised 256K, served 64K) that got that tier deleted. Flag the misleading 16384 but do NOT change it: ptait01 compose is a host-level change needing its own approval and takes --env-file ptait01-inference.env. *** rpm: 20 IS MANDATORY ON ALL FOUR ROWS. Measured today: LiteLLM simple_shuffle weights by rpm and defaults a MISSING key to 0, so an rpm-less deployment beside an rpm=20 one gets weight 0 and is NEVER SELECTED - that is precisely why one 3090 sat idle all day. *** FOUR ROWS: aliases `ornith-1.5--256k` (repo <alias>--<N>k convention) AND a bare `ornith-1.5`, each with two rows, api_base http://192.168.21.110:11441 and :11438; model ollama_chat/ornith-1.5:9b-256k; max_input_tokens 262144; max_tokens ~32768; supports_vision true; and NO num_ctx param - sending one RELOADS AND RESIZES the live lane out from under running work. *** SCOPE SPLIT: a harness run is NEVER given credentials. You will NOT have the master key and must NOT call /model/new, /model/update, /model/delete or /config/update against UAT or prod. YOU PREPARE AND PROVE, THE OVERSEER EXECUTES: an idempotent script that prints the exact four bodies, a read-back-and-diff script, the doc and test changes, and a plain statement of what proves the lane really serves 256K. *** ORDER: UAT FIRST (CT204) then prod (CT202 192.168.21.161:4000). NOTE CT204 MOVED TODAY - it now runs on host ptait07 (.138) with the container still at 192.168.21.162; re-measure rather than trusting any doc including this one. READ BACK EVERY ROW with GET /model/info - a 200 is NOT proof, /model/update has returned 200 while SILENTLY IGNORING max_input_tokens. *** REPO: docs and tests only. Update design docs/handoff-docs/ornith-db-owned-local-lane.md with both aliases plus measured ctx/VRAM; SKIP the litellm-config.yaml pointer comment entirely (even comment-only recreates prod); e2e/suites/02-litellm-models.test.js assert ornith-1.5--256k in /v1/models; e2e/suites/13-litellm-model-inference.test.js add to LOCAL_MODELS ~L298 plus assert /model/info max_input_tokens==262144 and /api/ps context_length==262144 per lane, reusing the existing QWEN38_LANES guard ~L645. *** VERIFY BY COUNTING GPU ARRIVALS, NOT THE 200: send one UNIQUE-prompt chat per lane and count POST "/api/chat" in docker logs --since on BOTH daemons - a cached response returns 200 with zero arrivals and has fooled this project before. Counting traps: the GIN line is quoted and MULTI-SPACE so a naive grep matches nothing; --since parses a bare timestamp as HOST LOCAL time not UTC; and the log writes only on COMPLETION so an in-flight request is invisible. Also run a ~150K-token long-context smoke test that must succeed WITHOUT falling back to the context-window cloud chain. Then `cd e2e && npx jest suites/02 suites/13` green on UAT, then prod. *** TWO MEASURED NOTES, neither a blocker and neither to be 'fixed' silently: GPU1 was ~3x slower but was already at 95% load from other traffic, so likely CONTENTION - UNCONFIRMED, do not state as fact; and OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=8 is set on both containers but this model serves one request at a time per instance (hybrid SSM, arch qwen35, n_seq_max=1) so it has no effect - the doc and containers disagree, harmless. *** Branch + PR, no direct push to main, do NOT merge.
